verdict.rationale: Extend documents schema-driven extraction that returns the values your schema defines, with typed custom fields (Date, Currency) and per-field confidence scores. It also documents table detection and agentic OCR for tables in parsing. However, no evidence explicitly shows tables mapped into arrays of typed rows ready for database loading. Missing for 10: documented table-to-row/array-of-objects extraction, evidence of output that loads without cleanup (normalization, null handling), and independent hands-on corroboration of table extraction quality.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I turn extracted tables into typed rows/JSON I can load into a database without manual cleanup
